title: Lovely Experience!!!
text: The best time of my trip to Seville, the host was lovely and the group was super friendly. The best moment was the Iberian ham tasting, an experience to be repeated.
author: C746SRjamest

title: Lovely!
text: Delicious, authentic, and surprisingly educational. I never knew how complex and rich the world of Spanish cured meats could be. Great atmosphere, generous tastings, and plenty of local charm!
author: xlucygl

title: Ugly and Delicious Tour
text:
Tour company was great about accommodating us with an alternate tour when "Pork Paradise" bookings were not sufficient for that tour. 
Our guide, Lucia, was very knowledgeable and we appreciated her presentation of historical information which made this tour very good.
author: Pamela_F
